ly = (-0.791, 0.612)
def place_block(oid, d, axis):
    rr = primitives.call(name='inspect_cliport_instance', object_id=oid)
    if not rr.ok:
        print('inspect fail', oid); return None
    out = rr.output
    p = out['instance'].get('pose0')
    pick = [[p[0][0], p[0][1], p[0][2]], [0, 0, 0, 1]]
    place = [[bx + d*axis[0], by + d*axis[1], 0.03], q]
    a = primitives.call(name='submit_cliport_pick_place_action', pick_pose=pick, place_pose=place,
                        evidence_ids=[out.get('evidence_id'), box_ev], source_object_id=oid, target_object_id=5)
    s = str(a.output); k = s.find('reward')
    print(oid, a.ok, s[k-10:k+80] if k >= 0 else '')
    return a
def show():
    r = primitives.call(name='inspect_cliport_instances')
    for i in r.output.get('instances', []):
        if i.get('object_id') in (5, 6, 7):
            print(i.get('object_id'), [round(x, 4) for x in i.get('pose0')[0]])
place_block(7, 0.032, ly)
show()

lx = (0.612, 0.791)
def getpos():
    r = primitives.call(name='inspect_cliport_instances')
    return {i.get('object_id'): i.get('pose0')[0] for i in r.output.get('instances', [])}
def move(oid, xyz, quat):
    rr = primitives.call(name='inspect_cliport_instance', object_id=oid)
    p = rr.output['instance'].get('pose0')
    a = primitives.call(name='submit_cliport_pick_place_action', pick_pose=[list(p[0]), [0,0,0,1]],
        place_pose=[xyz, quat], evidence_ids=[rr.output.get('evidence_id'), box_ev], source_object_id=oid, target_object_id=5)
    s = str(a.output); k = s.find("'reward'")
    print('move', oid, a.ok, s[k:k+40] if k >= 0 else '')
move(7, [0.45, -0.32, 0.03], [0,0,0,1])
move(6, [bx - 0.033*lx[0], by - 0.033*lx[1], 0.03], q)
P = getpos()
print({k: [round(v,4) for v in P[k]] for k in (5,6,7)})
axis = lx
if P[6][2] > 0.032:
    axis = ly
    move(6, [bx - 0.033*ly[0], by - 0.033*ly[1], 0.03], q)
    P = getpos(); print('retry6', [round(v,4) for v in P[6]])
move(7, [bx + 0.033*axis[0], by + 0.033*axis[1], 0.03], q)
P = getpos()
print({k: [round(v,4) for v in P[k]] for k in (5,6,7)})
